target.title: fix(telegram): dedupe directive-tag prompt context
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #99117.

Telegram direct-message prompt context currently dedupes session transcript rows against Telegram cache rows using `timestamp_ms` plus exact body text. When the transcript copy still contains inline directive tags such as `[[reply_to_current]]` but the Telegram cache copy contains the displayed text, both rows survive and the model sees the same assistant reply twice.

This PR moves the dedupe-key helper into a small Telegram-owned module and normalizes the body with the existing public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking` display stripping helper before constructing the timestamp/body key. The timestamp remains part of the key, preserving the timestamp-alignment behavior from #98769 while making directive-tag variants compare as the same visible reply.

## Verification

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- Red check: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.js').catch((err)=>{ console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); })"` failed before implementation with missing module.
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts').then(({resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey})=>{ const a=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I\'m here now.'}); const b=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}); const c=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474761000,body:'Yep - I\'m here now.'}); if(a!==b) throw new Error('directive-stripped keys did not match'); if(a===c) throw new Error('timestamp alignment was lost'); console.log('prompt-context dedupe assertions passed'); })"`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts`
- `node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=src-outside-plugin-sdk`
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "Promise.all([import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts'), import('./extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts')]).then(()=>console.log('telegram prompt-context imports resolved'))"`
- `git diff --check`

Known local proof gaps:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts` and `pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts -- --run` did not reach test output in this Windows worktree before being stopped; raw `pnpm exec vitest run extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts` repeatedly stayed in workspace compile/plugin timing output and was stopped after no test result appeared.
- `pnpm exec tsgo -p extensions/telegram/tsconfig.json --noEmit` is not a valid local narrow check in this worktree as-is; it fails on many existing `openclaw/plugin-sdk/*` type-resolution errors unrelated to this diff.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` failed before review with Windows `NotADirectoryError: [WinError 267]` while spawning `git`, including through a temporary `subst` ASCII drive.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Telegram DM prompt context no longer keeps both the synthetic session transcript assistant row and the Telegram cache assistant row when the only body difference is inline directive tags stripped for display.

Real environment tested: Local Windows source worktree, focused helper/runtime import proof.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: See `Verification` above.

Evidence after fix: The focused helper assertion showed `[[reply_to_current]]Yep - I'm here now.` and `Yep - I'm here now.` produce the same dedupe key at the same timestamp, while a different timestamp still produces a different key.

Observed result after fix: `prompt-context dedupe assertions passed`; `telegram prompt-context imports resolved`.

What was not tested: Live Telegram DM proof and local Vitest completion were not completed in this worktree.
